summary: Market-strategy intelligence review for V30/V31 decision flow. Focus: covered call assignment guard, technical-direction alignment, and next-rule hygiene for Iron Condor and intraday strategy governance.

hypotheses.observed_practice: Covered call assignment risk increases materially around ex-dividend when assignment can reduce expected premium, especially when the investor cannot tolerate assignment timing.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Keep covered-call candidates blocked when ex-dividend is imminent by treating `ex_dividend_soon` or `days_until_ex_dividend<=5` as a hard risk blocker (`COVERED_CALL_ASSIGNMENT_RISK`).
hypotheses.blocked_from_entry_ready_until: Implemented in rule gate (`RISK_BLOCKED`) and verified by V29 guard fixture scenario.
promotion_requirements: Persist ex-dividend fields consistently through broker and technical snapshots
Keep blocked state as `RISK_BLOCKED` even with complete option/technical confirmation
Dashboard and GPT payloads include explicit `covered_call_assignment_risk` reason flag
Fixture/guard coverage for true/false boundary cases

hypotheses.observed_practice: Naked put readiness quality degrades if technical context is bullish for puts but signal context is bearish/neutral; direction-aware confirmation reduces low-quality prompts.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Require strategy-specific technical direction compatibility before confirming technical readiness for each option strategy.
hypotheses.blocked_from_entry_ready_until: Rule already implemented in V29 technical confirmation path with explicit reason codes.
promotion_requirements: Log technical mismatch reason with canonical blocker ordering
Add fixture coverage for trend-strategy mismatches by strategy family
Monitor mismatch frequency in outcomes to tune trend thresholds

hypotheses.observed_practice: Four-leg spread strategies are highly sensitive to execution quality and volatility regime without explicit max-risk and exit governance.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Iron Condor should remain radar-only until multi-leg contract schema, max-risk envelope, and deterministic exit/invalidation rules are canonical and tested.
hypotheses.blocked_from_entry_ready_until: Canonical multi-leg schema and exit governance are required for production readiness.
promotion_requirements: Add forced-risk-cap fixture set (max risk, spread width, assignment window)
Pilot forward-test with radar-only outcome labels before any cap bump
